subject: Re: CuBERT status - decision: ship the fine-tune, drop our own pre-training
body:
Decision for the Jul 24 packet.

We ship review triage on the fine-tuned released checkpoint. 0.68 F1 vs 0.51 keyword baseline is a real improvement and it exists today. We are dropping in-house pre-training from this project entirely - a 34%-smaller corpus was never going to buy back its cost, and widening the extraction is a quarter of work that has to compete for Q3 OKRs on its own merits, not sneak in as a milestone.

Gustavo, two asks for the packet: state the 0.79 -> 0.68 dedup story explicitly, and give Nadia the false-positive rate at the operating threshold, because that's the first question the board will ask.

Alina - release the vulcan reservation for the last week of June, we don't need it. Please do that today so someone else can use it.

Good, disciplined quarter.

Priya
